A '''gas chamber''' was a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] component. It stored the [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] used in the weapon. The chamber was connected to the [[gas refill valve]] which allowed the blaster to have its expended gas refilled. Pulling the weapon's trigger opened the [[Heter-Valve]], which allowed small amounts of blaster gas to leave the gas chamber and pass into the [[XCiter/Legends|XCiter]].<ref name="CRFG" />
